canonical_statement: Object-level claim from the source metadata: the Schwartz space consists of smooth complex-valued functions on a finite-dimensional real vector space whose derivatives decrease faster than every inverse polynomial. The metadata does not determine a single theorem proposition.

conclusion: f belongs to the Schwartz space; a non-circular exact proposition must be selected in the statement phase
